about: Aramayo and Ho, APC is a personal injury firm with a single office in Glendale.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 1 of 4 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 3 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, incomplete: an adverse namesake we cannot resolve
G2.evidence: No disciplinary record is held against any of the 1 attorneys we identified. Victor Ho could not be told apart from 8 namesakes, one of whom is not eligible to practise. Held open.
G2.unresolvable: A namesake carries an adverse status and the register holds no field that would tell the two people apart

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 4 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 63 public reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum; time in operation still to confirm

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar B (0/15).
